title: [CDCSDK] [PG Parity] Postgres crash in StartupReplicationSlots, in nemesis testcase
body:
Jira Link: [DB-10741](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-10741)
### Description

Please find run link in JIRA. There are bunch of postgres crashes on all the nodes. They are not extracted for in the report. Below stacktrace was extracted manually.

```
(lldb) target create "/home/yugabyte/yb-software/yugabyte-2.23.0.0-b115-centos-x86_64/postgres/bin/postgres" --core "core_627010"
Core file '/home/yugabyte/cores/core_627010' (x86_64) was loaded.
(lldb) bt all
* thread #1, name = 'postgres', stop reason = signal SIGABRT
  * frame #0: 0x00007fdf9f601acf libc.so.6`raise + 271
    frame #1: 0x00007fdf9f5d4ea5 libc.so.6`abort + 295
    frame #2: 0x00005581813433dc postgres`errfinish(dummy=<unavailable>) at elog.c:817:3
    frame #3: 0x000055818112671e postgres`StartupReplicationSlots [inlined] RestoreSlotFromDisk(name=<unavailable>) at slot.c:0:3
    frame #4: 0x0000558181126202 postgres`StartupReplicationSlots at slot.c:1291:3
    frame #5: 0x0000558180d42404 postgres`StartupXLOG at xlog.c:6763:2
    frame #6: 0x00005581810d5e4a postgres`StartupProcessMain at startup.c:211:2
    frame #7: 0x0000558180d712be postgres`AuxiliaryProcessMain(argc=2, argv=0x00007ffdaec8c420) at bootstrap.c:447:4
    frame #8: 0x00005581810cf8c9 postgres`StartChildProcess(type=StartupProcess) at postmaster.c:5715:3
    frame #9: 0x00005581810cc462 postgres`PostmasterMain(argc=25, argv=0x0000353b7fd101a0) at postmaster.c:1426:15
    frame #10: 0x0000558180fcc46a postgres`PostgresServerProcessMain(argc=25, argv=0x0000353b7fd101a0) at main.c:234:3
    frame #11: 0x0000558180c7f612 postgres`main + 34
    frame #12: 0x00007fdf9f5edd85 libc.so.6`__libc_start_main + 229
    frame #13: 0x0000558180c7f52e postgres`_start + 46
```

![Screenshot 2024-04-05 at 8 49 21 AM](https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/assets/109518123/b079f1cf-8454-45ba-a8d8-f8bdeca67707)


**Testcase**: `test_cdc_tx_with_nemesis`, contains explicit transactions with UPDATE and DELETE as well.

### Source connector version

`fourpointfour/ybdb-debezium:0.2`
